content.rationale: Quiet refusal is where routing meets the excluded-effects clauses; the gate forces each exclusion to answer to the source that states it. Its three edges span two cells — two prose parents (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
